summary: The frames people stop for are the Ha Long karst, the Ha Giang road in the mist, Hoi An’s covered bridge, and Ban Gioc from the Vietnam bank.
body: Ha Long is the limestone from the boat. Ha Giang is the loop, with the road leaving town toward the passes. Hoi An’s bridge is the short covered span at the west end of the old town. Ban Gioc needs its own morning. Paradise Cave is the dry hall, not a second boat.

Da Nang’s bridges and the Marble Mountains sit on the road you are already taking. Ninh Binh and Tam Coc are karst, rice, and the boat. Sapa’s valleys are the terraces below town. Mist will take the picture some mornings. That is the place.
